venues.name: KeyBank Center
venues.address: 1 Seymour H Knox III Plaza, Buffalo, NY 14203
venues.notes: Home of the Buffalo Sabres (NHL). Also hosts concerts, Bandits lacrosse, and large events. Located on the waterfront at Canalside — game nights heavily impact Erie, Scott, Pearl, and Washington St parking.

venues.name: Highmark Stadium
venues.note: In Orchard Park, not Buffalo proper — events still create downtown parking demand and surface lot usage near Metro Rail stops.
venues.notes: Home of the Buffalo Bills (NFL). Orchard Park location but fan traffic affects Southtowns and park-and-ride lots. New stadium (Pegula Sports & Entertainment) under construction nearby as of 2024.

venues.name: Sahlen Field
venues.address: 1 James D Griffin Plaza, Buffalo, NY 14203
venues.note: Downtown Buffalo ballpark — walkable from Main St corridor.
venues.notes: Home of the Buffalo Bisons (Triple-A, Blue Jays affiliate). Season April–September. Games increase evening parking demand on Washington, Oak, and Pearl St corridors.

venues.name: UB North Campus
venues.note: Amherst — outside city limits. Graduation ceremonies in May draw large crowds.
venues.notes: University at Buffalo main campus. Football and basketball events create some traffic but primary impact is on Amherst/Cheektowaga, not Buffalo proper.

note: Used to overlay Sabres/Bills/Bisons home season heatmap pinpoints. Specific game dates require external schedule data; this captures the recurring seasonal patterns. KeyBank Center and Sahlen Field are within Buffalo city limits and directly affect city parking enforcement.
